scope: Heldout retrieval/ranking quality only: Vector vs Hybrid RRF vs Hybrid RRF + fixed Reranker. No LLM generation and no tuning.

hybrid_reranker.flow: same Hybrid RRF candidates -> fixed Cross-Encoder -> ranked results

metric_definition.hit_rate: at least one relevant document occurs in Top-K
metric_definition.recall: unique relevant documents in Top-K / all relevant documents
metric_definition.mrr: reciprocal rank of the first relevant document within Top-K
metric_definition.comparison_rule: At each K, compare (Recall@K, MRR@K) lexicographically; exact ties are equal. The rule is declared before heldout results.

strict_chunk_labeled_subset.limitation: Diagnostic only: the heldout subset has strict chunk labels only for q027.

pairwise_comparisons.comparison_definition: At each K compare (Recall@K, MRR@K) lexicographically; exact ties are equal.

unanswerable_handling.policy: Unanswerable queries are excluded from standard relevance aggregates and are not evaluated for abstention or generation in W7-T3.

timing_policy: Warmup used one tuning query. Timing is a local sanity signal only, is not used for quality conclusions, and does not replace W7-T4.
claim_boundary: The run evaluates five heldout answerable queries only.
Primary metrics are document-level; q027 is the only strict chunk diagnostic.
The evaluation does not measure LLM answer quality or latency trade-offs.
The frozen configuration was not changed after heldout results.
